title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Efficiency and safety of road transport within the project area and between countries improved.

Average vehicle travel time from Ulaanbaatar to Altanbulag reduced by at least 10%. Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Not yet due. Data Source: Project progress and completion report Baseline value: 300 min

Traffic accidents reduced by 15% in four project aimags. Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Not yet due. • For the Ulaanbaatar-Darkhan road, 162 traffic accidents (122 registered in 2022) resulting in 25 deaths and 58 injuries were recorded in 2023. As of 2024, 255 traffic accidents had been registered, with 19 deaths and 48 injuries. • For the Arvaikheer-Khuiten Valley road, 9 traffic accidents, 0 death and 6 injuries were recorded in 2023. In 2024, 10 accidents and 1 death and 2 injures were registered. • For Darkhan-Altanbulag road, 33 road accidents, 4 deaths and 7 injuries were recorded in 2024. Data Source: National Police statistics Baseline value: 101 deaths, 244 inj
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Due diligence reports for project preparation prepared Indicator: Due diligence reports prepared for 257 km Chinggis-Norovlin-Dadal road improvement Achievement: N Progress/Status: The due diligence report was submitted to MRTD by the Construction Supervision Consultant in 2019. Data Source: Quarterly progress reports of PIU Actual value: N

Output: Road asset management capacity and implementation improved Indicator: At least 30 staff, including at least 50% women who attended training, report improved RAM skills Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Under TA 9544-MON, policy advice was delivered, and six capacity-building training sessions were conducted on road maintenance and road asset management. A total of 57 staff members attended the workshops, including representatives from MRTD, RTDC, the Capital City Road Development Department, and local maintenance companies. Of the attendees, 16 were female. Additionally, four PAVER™ 7 for Windows user licenses were provided to MRTD. From November 10-11, 2022, a Road Asset Management Systems workshop was held, with 26 trainees in attendance, including representatives from MRTD, RTDC, and consultants. In 2024, a training hosted by CSC on RAM and the Road Safety Audit Report was conducted, with 24 attendees, including 9 female participants. The target was successfully reached. Data Source: MRTD annual road maintenance report Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: 0 Target year: 2025 Target value: 30staff (50% women) Actual value: Y

Output: Road asset management capacity and implementation improved Indicator: RAM system established Achievement: Y Progress/Status: TA 9544 was implemented to support the RAM system establishment in the Mongolia Road industry between 2020-2021. Within the TA implementation trainings were conducted, 4 Paver software were purchased. Unfortunately, the software was not functioned as it was planned due to staff incapacity, and lack of the EA ownership on the TA implementation. In the meantime, to enhance the RAM system implementation in the Mongolian road sector, the EA has been demonstrating initiations to train the sector specialists and taking actions under other road projects funded by various development agencies. One of the examples, Commencing in 2024, the MRT in collaboration with the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport of the Republic of Korea, initiated the K-SMART Road Asset Management System project, with the objective of establishing a comprehensive, digitalized management system for state-owned roads. Data Source: MRTD annual road maintenance report and project quarterly progress report Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2025 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Output: Road condition improved Indicator: 500 people, of which at least 50% women, trained by local non-government organization in small business and income-generation methods applicable to the road corridor market. Achievement: N Progress/Status: Completed and reached the target. According to the Paragraph 14 of Terms of Reference for Construction Supervision Consulting Services, the Consultant hired Training and Evaluation Institute (TERI) to conduct the small business trainings for local residents and small business owners. TERI conducted a baseline study and needs assessment to ascertain the business competencies and existing training needs of the communities affected by the road construction. Training sessions were conducted in total of 12 soums from four provinces from December 2023 to January 2024. A total of 504 individuals participated, comprising 327 in the Financial literacy module and 177 in the Business Planning module. 75% of the participants in the training were female. Data Source: Quarterly progress reports of PIU Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: 0 Target year: 2028 Target value: 500 (50%wom) trained Actual value: N

Output: Road condition improved Indicator: The 320.6 km Ulaanbaatar-Altanbulag and 57.6 km Khuiten Valley-Arvaikheer road sections rehabilitated to good condition or intrenational roughness index of 4 or below. Achievement: N Progress/Status: The Ulaanbaatar-Darkhan and Khuiten Valley-Arvaikheer roads rehabilitation construction works have been ongoing since 2019 and 2021 respectively. As of 11 Jant 2025, the progress of the UB-Darkhan road project stands at 94.93%, while Khuiten Valley-Arvaikheer road section has reached 98.50%. Maintenance work on the Darkhan-Altanbulag road section commenced in October 2023, and by the end of the 2024 construction season, the progress reached 100%. As of 31 December 2025, the Ulaanbaatar-Darkhan road (UD1 package) is 98.51% complete. The rehabilitation of the Arvaikheer-Khuiten Valley road section (UA1 package) was finalized in November 2023, with performance-based maintenance currently ongoing at the site. The overall progress for this package stands at 98.50%. Data Source: Quarterly progress reports of PIU Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: 0 km Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: 0 km Target year: 2028 Target value: 378.2 km Actual value: N

Output: Road safety improved Indicator: 1200 residents (at least 50% women) reported improved awareness on road safety and related activities as a result of road safety training. Progress/Status: Completed and reached the target. In October and November 2024, the Project Implementation Unit organized a series of training activities that included training sessions tailored for both residents and drivers. These initiatives were designed to raise awareness about existing road safety legislation and the importance of adhering to it. During these events, a total of 1503 locals participated, with an impressive 72% of the attendees being women from Songinokhairkhan district of Ulaanbaatar, Selenge province, Darkhan-Uul province, Uvurkhangai province and Tuv province. Data Source: Quarterly progress reports of PIU Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: 0 Target year: 2028 Target value: Improved awareness

Output: Road safety improved Indicator: 200 school-teachers (at least 70% women) trained as trainers on road safety ready to deliver trainings to school students Progress/Status: Completed and reached the target. MRT and PIU organized road safety training for school teachers, involving 13 soums from 3 aimags and Songinokhairkhan district in Ulaanbaatar. Thirty-three trained teachers intend to conduct similar training sessions in their respective soums and district, aiming to reach the project's target number of teachers. Additional training sessions was conducted in September and October including a total of 325 schoolteachers (68 male and 257 female teachers). Data Source: Quarterly progress reports of PIU Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: 0 Target year: 2028 Target value: Delivered trainings

Output: Road safety improved Indicator: Road safety facility, including road markings, barriers, and guide posts, rehabilitated or installed in 320.6 km Ulaanbaatar-Altanbulag and 57.6km Khuiten Valley-Arvaikheer road sections. Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: As per technical specifications, the road sections have been furnished with the required guard rails, road signs and road markings.
